others.notes: High risk consent. Plan: subarachnoid block or general anaesthesia, with or without a block. Pantoprazole 40 mg at night and at 6 am, antidiabetic medicines withheld, IV fluid with neutralising insulin in DNS, Duolin and Budecort nebulisation at night and 30 minutes before the procedure; pulmonology clearance to be reviewed on the morning of surgery.

others.name: Operation report: what was done
others.notes: Right lateral decubitus, Southern Moore approach with a 15 cm curved incision. Fractured femoral head extracted; 28 mm head chosen; 40 mm cement stopper and a cemented femoral stem size 8 in about 15 degrees of anteversion. Drain placed. Above knee compression and knee immobilizer applied; shifted out with stable vitals. Counts verified. Approximate blood loss 200 ml.

_source.asWritten: a head size of 28mm was chosen. Broaching was done on femur serially from small to larger size (till 9 size) keeping anteversion ~15 degree. Trial implants were placed; head reduced and hip range of movements assessed. Cement stopper (40mm) was inserted in the femoral canal. A cemented femoral stem (size 8) inserted in approximately 15 degrees of anteversion. Irrigation done, hemostasis achieved and drain placed. Capsular layer sutured with vicryl no.1, short external rotators sutured through transosseously with GT. Deep fascia closed with Stratafix and subcutaneus closure done with Vicryl 1-0. Skin closed with stratafix. Above knee compression & knee immobilizer were applied and patient shifted out with stable vitals
